subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Diné Digital Archive is an online archive curated by the Navajo Nation.
• It features images of many cultural artifacts relevant to the history of the Navajo people.
• It features textiles, including a woven rug (diyogí in Navajo) made from wool.
• The woven rug was made in 2021.
• The archive features jewelry, including a concho belt (sis ligaii) made from silver.
• The concho belt was made in the 1880s.
prompt: The student wants to support the claim that the online archive features both older and newer artifacts. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: The silver concho belt (sis ligaii) was made in the 1880s.
choices.B: The Diné Digital Archive online archive features cultural artifacts both old and new, including a silver concho belt from the 1880s and a wool rug from 2021.
choices.C: Not all artifacts in the Diné Digital Archive are from the 1880s.
choices.D: Diné Digital Archive, an online archive, features both textiles and jewelry.

explanation: Choice B is the best answer because it directly supports the claim that the archive contains both older and newer artifacts by providing specific evidence from two distinct time periods. The choice explicitly states the archive features artifacts 'both old and new,' then synthesizes relevant information from the notes by citing the silver concho belt from the 1880s (demonstrating older artifacts) and the wool rug from 2021 (demonstrating newer artifacts). This pairing of concrete examples from widely separated time periods effectively establishes the archive's temporal range.
